Use the substitution \(u = \sin(x)\), so \(du = \cos(x)*dx\).

\[
\int -2*\sin(x)*\cos(x)\,dx = -2 * \int u * du = -u**2 + C = -\sin(x)**2 + C
\]

<answer>-sin(x)**2 + C</answer>
